policy: Actual approved identity files supplied for the Saul edit; other two scenes contain no identifiable recurring people. Genesis 7 is style only. Superseded assets retained.

images.purpose: Remove royal circlet for the disguise at 1 Samuel 28:8; preserve all visible identities and composition.
images.review: Original and 1200×675 packaged version inspected at full native resolution. Circlet removed. Saul remains recognizable against the Endor v1 and rejection references; woman and two companions preserved. No clear malformed visible anatomy. Hidden limbs remain unverified.

images.purpose: Introduce the house at Kiriath Jearim in 7:1–2 rather than repeat the existing Ebenezer scene at 7:2.
images.review: Original and 960×540 packaged version inspected at full native resolution. Empty courtyard/closed house, no people or standing stone. Existing Samuel Story image and verse placement retained.

images.purpose: Replace oversized pea-like crop with fine compound leaves and small short lentil pods consistent with 23:11.
images.review: Original and 960×540 packaged version inspected at full native resolution. Fine paired leaflets and small pods replace the broad leaves and swollen pods. No people or animals; shield and field role retained. Imagined crop, not a species-identification photograph.
